_comment_urls: Use 'Urls', NOT a 'Kestrel:Endpoints' block. A Kestrel endpoints block takes precedence over --urls and ASPNETCORE_URLS, which silently defeats 'run.bat <port>'. Command-line configuration is layered after appsettings, so this key is a default the command line can override.
_comment_lab: Relative paths resolve against the REPOSITORY ROOT (nearest ancestor with a .sln), not the executable - otherwise sessions would live in bin/ and be destroyed by a rebuild. Point DefaultCorpusPath at your documents, or set INDEXING_LAB_CORPUS. For machine-specific absolute paths copy appsettings.local.json.example to appsettings.local.json (git-ignored).
